assessment.identity: Heterogeneous high-grade monazite ore supplied by Lynas Rare Earths, Australia; precise deposit unspecified in this source. It is not a species identifier, pure Ce/Nd phosphate, commodity or secondary waste.
assessment.organism: Klebsiella aerogenes ATCC13048; current NCBI Taxonomy548 verified. ATCC catalogue former Enterobacter aerogenes and type-strain mapping corroborated; experimental stock not independently sequenced/authenticated.
assessment.preparation_conditions: Ore50-200um, gamma50kGy11h; later collective mounted-substrate wording0.5-2mm conflicts. Pregrowth3-5d,30C120rpm with phosphate/glucose. Mounted glass/adhesive specimens ethanol/UV treated,100mL phosphate-free NBRIP,initialpH6.2+/-0.4,30C140rpm,approximately1e7 flow-cytometry cells/mL,4h-day14. Separate1% live slurry continues day70; no unsupported w/v definition or mounted-volume transfer.
assessment.controls: Sterile NBRIP/Milli-Q controls for fluorescence and representative surface comparison. Methods controlpH6/5/4 versus live Methods andS6 pH7/5/4. Glutaraldehyde is enumeration-aliquot fixation. Hoechst/DiTO-1 fluorescence is not CFU or live-specific; epoxy autofluoresces. No documented inoculum wash, ore-free phosphorus-limited growth control, quantitative erosion replication or matched pH trajectory.
assessment.outcomes: CLSM/SEM/FIB evidence of cell attachment and biofilm on ore. Qualitative day14 erosion comparison; no new aqueous-REE release, percentage extraction, closed mass balance, isolated product or industrial deployment. No detected chemical-composition preference in examined grains; roughness association. Contact/acid/EPS causation remains inferred.
assessment.quantitative_boundaries: SI S3 crystalline-only monazite-group65 wt%, other listed3/15/18, arithmetic101 versusprintedtotal100; notwhole-feed grade. S1 Ce+cheralite refinement versusS2 Ce/La referencepatterns, overlappingcrandallite/florencite andtentativekihlmanite. No new denominator or mineralID from these estimates. Prior2017/2018 REE concentrations are cited context, not2023 measurements.
assessment.overlap: Current Ce/Nd mineral identities, Nd synthetic mixed-phosphate evidence and He2024 xenotime concentrate are different material/study owners. VanAlin2023 was known/deferred in prior source inventories includinground50; this is newly accepted complete evidence, not a newly discovered DOI or proof of independent replication of earlier Lynas ore studies.
